column1: # project map: one row per area. Columns are tab-separated. `tools/where.py <words>` searches it; `tests/check_map.py` keeps it true.
# stack: Python 3 standard library only; unittest; no dependencies; one command, bin/agentify
# rules: edit the archetype master not a project copy; init never overwrites; every check rule has a break-it test; no network

column2: read a project: stack, areas, tests, existing agent files
init and upgrade: write the agent files without overwriting (an empty docs/style.md only if there is no style guide and a new root CLAUDE.md)
the lint: map true, budgets, no placeholders, every rule backed by an enforcer, a style-guide section or a stated judgment
where.py: search the map in about 100 tokens
maintenance: worklist of dead, missing, undescribed and stale map rows; pre-commit hook
tokens loaded at the start of a session; saving against a git ref; budget gate
A/B benchmark: fresh headless sessions answering fixed questions; real tokens and cost
